### Front line

According to the Ukrainian monitoring group DeepStateMap, Russian forces gained 4.7 square kilometers of newly occupied territory (advancing into 40% of Matiasheve and 26% of Shevchenko in the Pokrovskyi raion, Donetsk Oblast). Additionally, 8.2 square kilometers transitioned from Ukrainian-held to contested, affecting areas in Vodianske (48%), Krasnopodillia (34%), Svitle (6%), and Dobropillia (2%). 

The Russian Ministry of Defence claimed that its "East" grouping assaulted and controlled roughly 13 square kilometers around Nikolske in Zaporizhzhia Oblast. A Russian serviceman claimed the capture of Petrovske in the Donetsk region, alleging it brought the Dobropillia–Kramatorsk road under fire control. The Russian Ministry of Defence further claimed that "North" grouping forces continued to tighten encirclements around Ukrainian units in Kharkiv Oblast, while its artillery struck Ukrainian strongpoints near the Oskil Reservoir and in Zaporizhzhia. None of these Russian territorial claims have been independently verified.

### Strikes and losses

The Russian Ministry of Defence claimed that its air defenses intercepted 674 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones over two periods across numerous Russian regions, occupied Crimea, and the Sea of Azov. The Russian ministry also claimed group strikes using ground-based precision weapons and drones, alleging hits on a Kyiv missile and long-range drone production workshop at "Pulp Mill Print," the Darnytsia locomotive depot, a drone warehouse in Mykolaiv Oblast, a drone storage site in the Kyiv region, and a cargo vessel in the Bug Estuary purportedly carrying military supplies. Russian forces also claimed air and artillery strikes on Ukrainian drone control points and troop concentrations in Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts.

GeoConfirmed geolocations showed unverified Russian drone strikes in Kherson targeting civilian vehicles, an FPV drone strike targeting a vehicle in Kramatorsk, and a strike targeting a claimed Ukrainian Ridgeback MRAP. A neutral entry on GeoConfirmed documented damage to Building No. 3 of Rivne State University of Humanities from a reported Russian drone strike, as well as a damaged house elsewhere that reportedly injured three people. Ukrainian police reported via GeoConfirmed that falling debris from an intercepted Russian drone injured two women in Kyiv’s Orlyatko park. In Glushkovo, Kursk Oblast, footage reportedly showed a Russian BTR-80 destroyed by Ukraine's 17th Separate Heavy Mechanized Brigade. The Economist war-fire model registered zero satellite fire detections classified as war-related.

### Official statements

The Ukrainian Ministry of Defence reported that the Cabinet of Ministers approved an additional 60 billion UAH for the defense forces, with 43.5 billion allocated for personnel payments and 16.6 billion for ammunition, drones, electronic warfare, and repairs. The ministry also announced draft legislation to direct all defense-export permit fees toward military procurement and salaries, as well as measures allowing service members to register for housing lists at their duty station. Ukraine and NATO jointly developed two AI models ("Model No. 13" for forecasting hostile drone attacks and "Model No. 32" for artillery planning).

The Russian Ministry of Defence announced strategic defense dialogue talks with a Vietnamese military delegation and reported that Deputy Defence Minister Vitaly Shulika attended a diplomatic reception marking relations with North Korea, where he praised North Korean personnel for their reported role in engineering and clearing operations in Kursk Oblast.
